correctness.rationale: The optimal quadratic pullback is permutation-averaged and therefore Euclidean on the standard zero-sum representation; Cauchy–Schwarz/projection signs give the exact sphere maximum, and saturated positive/negative mass transfers give the exact ball radius. Every boundary and n=2,3 are treated. Differentiating (j+rho²)/(j+rho)² proves the unique minimizer for n≥4. A separate exact-rational checker reproduces 310298 finite grid vectors and 210 algebraic checks, not an infinite proof.
